events.content:
Done. `ProductGallery.tsx` now renders an image for each product, and the type check passes.

Following the existing pattern in `app/page.tsx`, each product gets a Next.js `<Image>` component with `src={product.imageUrl}`, `alt={product.name}`, and the requested 300×200 dimensions.

One thing I confirmed before writing the code, per the AGENTS.md warning: this Next.js version's bundled docs show the `Image` component still uses the familiar `src`/`alt`/`width`/`height` props, so the pattern from `page.tsx` carries over directly. (The docs do show one breaking change — `priority` has been replaced by `preload` — but that doesn't affect lazy-loaded gallery images. Note that the existing `priority` usage in `page.tsx:15` may be worth updating separately.)

Done. `ProductGallery.tsx` now renders an image for each product, and the type check passes.

Following the existing pattern in `app/page.tsx`, each product gets a Next.js `<Image>` component with `src={product.imageUrl}`, `alt={product.name}`, and the requested 300×200 dimensions.

One thing I confirmed before writing the code, per the AGENTS.md warning: this Next.js version's bundled docs show the `Image` component still uses the familiar `src`/`alt`/`width`/`height` props, so the pattern from `page.tsx` carries over directly. (The docs do show one breaking change — `priority` has been replaced by `preload` — but that doesn't affect lazy-loaded gallery images. Note that the existing `priority` usage in `page.tsx:15` may be worth updating separately.)
